move: smiley faces bounce in elastic, blink, bob, wink, then pop out
how: A cream landing page: nav, three masked headline lines rising yPercent:110 (expo.out, stagger 0.1) from 3%, paragraph and CTA following with back.out(1.6). On the right five coloured circle faces (inline SVG eyes/brows/mouths) enter from scale:0/y:80 with elastic.out(1,0.55) staggered 0.12 from 7%, then two testimonial pills scale in with back.out(2). During the hold (25%-80%) the faces bob y:-14 and rotate 5deg on sine.inOut yoyo, all eyes blink via scaleY:0.1 flashes at three moments, two mouths morph their SVG path d attribute (back.out(2) and sine.inOut yoyo), one face winks and another tilts 12deg, and the CTA pulses scale 1.06. Exit at 87%: faces shrink back with back.in(1.8) stagger 0.06, headline lines shoot up, nav slides off.
adapt: Swap brand name, headline, paragraph, CTA and pill text; recolour the five face circles and change their expressions (SVG path d for brows/mouths) or count; keep the elastic.out(1,0.55) entrance, the sine bob rhythm and the back.in exit. The face bob/blink schedule is absolute seconds and must scale with duration.
port: mount(el, shot) writes the nav/hero/faces/pills into el; animate(el, shot, D) builds the same timeline with all absolute times divided by 6 then multiplied by D and returns it. The mouth morphs are attr:{d} tweens on inline SVG, which port directly; every gsap.utils.toArray call must be scoped to el.
caveats: blink and wink timings are hard-coded seconds tuned to D=6
eye blinks use transformOrigin on SVG circles, which needs svgOrigin-safe handling in some browsers
emoji glyphs in the pills depend on system fonts
